title: Idealized ADC quantizer
text: 使用此模块对理想模数转换器进行建模；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定Interval between samples；{Quantization interval} 指定 Interval that defines quantization levels for the output、{Treat as gain when linearizing} 指定 the gain value，按实例取值。

params.name: Quantization interval
params.values: Interval that defines quantization levels for the output signal 0.5 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Treat as gain when linearizing
params.values: Specify the gain value on (default) | off
